name: who-gho-mcp
description: Keyless Cloudflare Worker MCP — typed WHO Global Health Observatory (GHO) OData access for the evidentia plugin: global/country disease-burden, mortality, risk-factor and coverage indicators. Tools who_gho_search_indicators / who_gho_query / who_gho_dimensions. Authless public GHO OData upstream (ghoapi.azureedge.net); closes evidentia's global-burden gap (PopHIVE is US-only).
